context.title: Load map and context
context.imperative: Read your inherited global doctrine (this skill's references/global-orchestrator.md and references/global-everyone.md), then the project deltas if present: docs/agents/ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT.md, docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md, and the current map (index + touched packets). Attest c1.

packets.title: Reconcile node packets
packets.imperative: Reconcile each touched node packet against the code with evidence; update wording, status/confidence, dependencies, and rationale.

index-overlays.title: Update index and overlays
index-overlays.imperative: Update the index and overlays to match the reconciled packets.

postconditions.statement: index and overlays consistent with packets

map-compliance.title: Verify map compliance
map-compliance.imperative: Verify map compliance. Record unresolved structural questions; flag future work as triage candidates.

postconditions.statement: map compliant; open structural questions recorded

triage_candidates.statement: MASS_SHARED_VARIANCE_FRACTION=0.8 (systematic_budget.py) is a documented judgment call, not a measurement -- flagged by G1 for architecture/Commander confirmation; unresolved, route to Triage rather than map.

G1's THETA_SENS_CDA_REL/RHO_SENS_PMAX_REL/THETA_SENS_PMAX_REL frozen constants are algebraically derived, not freshly live-measured (the Monza perturbation re-run stalled twice under multi-agent CPU contention, cites #644) -- re-run scripts/nuisance_sensitivity.py live once contention clears.

estimate_store_fields.py's cda/p_max systematic fallback path (_FALLBACK_SYSTEMATIC_REL, fires only when rho/mass_kg are missing) is test-only in production (estimate_batch.run_estimate_batch always supplies both) -- G4 flagged deciding whether to close it (require rho/mass as mandatory kwargs) or add an explicit fallback-provenance flag distinguishing a fallback-floored row from a real-budget-floored row.

G5's tier2-fracture doc: grip-triplet cross-term bound is ~0.6%, small enough a joint solve may not be worth building -- flagged so a future touch of the grip axes checks this number before re-litigating whether to build it.
